# Set plot themes

```{r theme plot}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",

      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
```

# Load data

```{r load data}
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(log10_depth = log10(reads),
         diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = c("Omnivore", "Vegetarian", "Vegan")))
cpm <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "cpm_gene_GPH.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene_family") %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var= "sample_id")
```

# Function

```{r PCoA}
run_pcoa <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  
  pcoa <- wcmdscale(distance_object, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = "lingoes")
  
  points <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
  colnames(points) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  
  eigs <- pcoa$eig
  positive_eigs <- eigs[eigs > 0]
  var_exp <- positive_eigs / sum(positive_eigs)
  
  pcoa_df <- bind_cols(metadata_df, points)
  
  list(pcoa = pcoa,
       points = pcoa_df,
       var_exp = var_exp)}

# Complete cases only (GPH_97 has no BMI), so PERMANOVA and betadisper use the same samples
complete_cases <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  model_df <- metadata_df %>%
    filter(if_all(c(diet_group, sex, age, bmi, log10_depth), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  list(model_df = model_df,
       distance = as.dist(as.matrix(distance_object)[model_df$sample_id, model_df$sample_id]))}

# PERMANOVA with the project covariates
run_adonis <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  cc <- complete_cases(distance_object, metadata_df)

  adonis2(
    cc$distance ~ diet_group + sex + age + bmi + log10_depth,
    data = cc$model_df,
    permutations = 9999,
    by = "margin")}

run_betadisper <- function(distance_object, metadata_df) {
  cc <- complete_cases(distance_object, metadata_df)
  betadisper(cc$distance, cc$model_df$diet_group, type = "median", bias.adjust = TRUE)}
```


# PCoA
```{r to matrix}
arg_mat <- cpm %>%
  select(-sample_id) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  apply(2,as.numeric)

rownames(arg_mat) <- cpm$sample_id

# Same sample order as metadata: PCoA points and adonis2 rely on row position
arg_mat <- arg_mat[metadata$sample_id, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r bray}
arg_rel <- decostand(
  arg_mat,
  method = "total")

dist_bray <- vegdist(arg_rel, method = "bray")

pcoa_bray <- run_pcoa(dist_bray, metadata)

adonis_bray <- run_adonis(dist_bray, metadata)

betadisper_bray <- run_betadisper(dist_bray, metadata)
betadisper_bray_test <- permutest(betadisper_bray, permutations = 9999)
```

```{r Hellinger}

arg_hellinger <- decostand(arg_mat, method = "hellinger")
dist_hellinger <- dist(arg_hellinger, method = "euclidean")

pcoa_hell <- run_pcoa(dist_hellinger, metadata)

adonis_hell <- run_adonis(dist_hellinger, metadata)

betadisper_hell <- run_betadisper(dist_hellinger, metadata)
betadisper_hell_test <- permutest(betadisper_hell, permutations = 9999)
```

```{r Aitchison}
dist_aitchison <- vegdist(
  arg_mat,
  method = "robust.aitchison"
)

pcoa_aitch <- run_pcoa(dist_aitchison, metadata)

adonis_aitch <- run_adonis(dist_aitchison, metadata)

betadisper_aitch <- run_betadisper(dist_aitchison, metadata)
betadisper_aitch_test <- permutest(betadisper_aitch, permutations = 9999)
```

```{r adonis results}
adonis_hell_df <- as.data.frame(adonis_hell) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(analysis = "Gene_Hellinger_Euclidean_CPM")

adonis_bray_df <- as.data.frame(adonis_bray) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(analysis = "Gene_Bray_Curtis_CPM")

adonis_aitch_df <- as.data.frame(adonis_aitch) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(analysis = "Gene_Aitchison_CPM")

adonis_results <- bind_rows(adonis_hell_df, adonis_bray_df,adonis_aitch_df)

print(adonis_results)
```

```{r betadisper results}
betadisper_results <- tibble(
  analysis = c(
    "Hellinger_Euclidean",
    "Bray_Curtis",
    "Aitchison"
  ),
  statistic = c(
    betadisper_hell_test$tab[1, "F"],
    betadisper_bray_test$tab[1, "F"],
    betadisper_aitch_test$tab[1, "F"]
  ),
  p_value = c(
    betadisper_hell_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
    betadisper_bray_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"],
    betadisper_aitch_test$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]
  )
)
betadisper_results
```

```{r save tables}
dir.create(here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_tsv(adonis_results, here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables", "beta_permanova.tsv"))
write_tsv(betadisper_results, here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables", "beta_betadisper.tsv"))

# PCoA coordinates and variance explained per axis, for the manuscript figures
imap_dfr(list(Hellinger_Euclidean = pcoa_hell, Bray_Curtis = pcoa_bray, Aitchison = pcoa_aitch),
         ~ .x$points %>%
           transmute(sample_id, diet_group, metric = .y, PC1, PC2,
                     var_PC1 = .x$var_exp[1], var_PC2 = .x$var_exp[2])) %>%
  write_tsv(here("0.-Diet_group", "Results", "Tables", "resistome_pcoa_all_metrics.tsv"))
```


# Plots

```{r Plot function}

plot_pcoa <- function(pcoa_object, title, subtitle, adonis_object) {
  
  df <- pcoa_object$points
  
  pc1_lab <- paste0(
    "PCoA1 [",
    round(pcoa_object$var_exp[1] * 100, 2),
    "%]")
  
  pc2_lab <- paste0(
    "PCoA2 [",
    round(pcoa_object$var_exp[2] * 100, 2),
    "%]")
  
  r2 <- adonis_object$R2[1]
  pval <- adonis_object$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  
  subtitle_full <- paste0(
    subtitle,
    ", p = ",
    signif(pval, 3))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = diet_group, colour = diet_group)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.20,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(
      pch = 21,
      size = 2.4,
      colour = "black",
      alpha = 0.90) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = diet_colors) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      subtitle = subtitle_full,
      x = pc1_lab,
      y = pc2_lab) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        colour = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 0.6))}
```

```{r}
plot_pcoa_hell <- plot_pcoa(
  pcoa_object = pcoa_hell,
  title = "Hellinger + Euclidean PCoA",
  subtitle = "Hellinger + Euclidean",
  adonis_object = adonis_hell)
plot_pcoa_hell

```

```{r}
plot_pcoa_bray
```
